evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Improve data testing, documentation, lineage, and reliability of analytical models.
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Responsibilities repeatedly emphasize data quality, testing, documentation, lineage, and consistent metric definitions with no velocity/speed language present, placing this at rigour.
evidence.domain_risk: Build analytical datasets supporting advertising performance, inventory optimization, audience segmentation, monetization, and revenue reporting.
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Errors affect revenue/monetization reporting (AVOD, subscription revenue, ARPU/LTV) at a media/streaming platform, a real business-decision consequence without financial-reporting or regulatory-audit language, placing this at moderate.
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: The JD describes an existing 'oneD team' with defined metric frameworks, established platforms (AVOD, SVOD, personalization), and a wide range of already-operating business domains (advertising, subscriptions, content, CRM), indicating a mature, specialized data organization.
evidence.jd_authorship: Define, document, and maintain business metrics including Active Users, Paid Subscribers, Churn, Retention, Renewal, Reactivation, Conversion, Watch Starts, Revenue, ARPU, and LTV.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Responsibilities name precise, extensive metric definitions (ARPU, LTV, fill rate, CPM, watch starts) and specific tools (dbt, Redshift/BigQuery/Snowflake/Databricks) that show exactly what the role does day to day, written by someone close to the work.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: power decision-making across AVOD, SVOD, personalization, product development, marketing, content, and core platform services
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role serves commercial (advertising/subscription revenue), product (personalization, experimentation), and internal-data (BI, dashboards) audiences roughly equally across its five responsibility sections, making this mixed.
evidence.autonomy_level: Act as the owner of business-facing metric definitions and trusted datasets.
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role owns metric definitions and establishes consistent business logic across the organization (strategic-leaning) while also building specific datasets for AVOD/SVOD/product domains in response to defined needs (execution), making this mixed.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: No AI tooling or AI-adjacent responsibility is mentioned anywhere in the JD.
evidence.testing_framing: Improve data testing, documentation, lineage, and reliability of analytical models.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Testing and data quality are framed as an owned responsibility within a dedicated 'Data Quality, Documentation & Governance' section with explicit ownership verbs (improve, reduce, partner), not just tools in a skills list.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Reduce duplicated business logic across reports, dashboards, and ad-hoc analysis. Partner with Data Engineers to improve upstream data quality and source data consistency.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Data consistency, reliability, and reduced duplication are named as ongoing secondary concerns without regulatory or stakeholder-trust framing dominating the JD, placing this at moderate.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Design and maintain trusted business data models covering users, subscriptions, content, viewing behavior, engagement, revenue, campaigns, and product events.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The JD mixes new-build language (design, build, develop, create) with maintain/improve language (maintain, improve, reduce duplication) roughly evenly across its five domain sections, making this mixed.
evidence.loss_aversion: Improve data testing, documentation, lineage, and reliability of analytical models — a secondary quality/consistency concern, not a dominant compliance risk register.
